cases.name: string_concat
cases.source_sql:
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.usp_greet @name NVARCHAR(100)
AS
BEGIN
  SELECT 'Hello, ' + @name AS greeting;
END

cases.name: datediff_seconds
cases.source_sql:
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.usp_elapsed
AS
BEGIN
  SELECT DATEDIFF(SECOND, '2026-01-01', '2026-01-01 00:02:00') AS secs;
END

cases.name: charindex_strpos
cases.source_sql:
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.usp_find
AS
BEGIN
  SELECT CHARINDEX('world', 'hello world') AS pos;
END
